source: Your Friday night date starts here.
raw:
{
  "literal": "موعدك ليلة الجمعة يبدأ هنا.",
  "adaptation": "ديت الخميس بتاعك بيبدأ من هنا.",
  "back_translation": "Your Thursday date starts from here.",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Changed 'Friday night' to Thursday since the Egyptian weekend kicks off on Thursday evening, and used the colloquial loanword 'ديت' (date) to resonate authentically with the young dating app demographic."
}
adaptation: ديت الخميس بتاعك بيبدأ من هنا.
back_translation: Your Thursday date starts from here.
notes: Changed 'Friday night' to Thursday since the Egyptian weekend kicks off on Thursday evening, and used the colloquial loanword 'ديت' (date) to resonate authentically with the young dating app demographic.
